design.rows: one simulated year (one seed of one cell) pooled from E17 (dispersion x standoff x pad radius) and E18 (keep-out), classical landings, driving-v1 legs, Connecting ridge terrain

responses.log_delay_prio1_mean_h: ln of the mean urgent-item delay (h); 100*(exp(b)-1) = % per unit
responses.sl24_prio1: share of urgent items delivered within 24 h (linear)
responses.cost_per_kg_usd: fleet + operator cost per delivered kg (linear)
responses.cost_per_kg_with_energy_usd_<p>: the same plus p $/kWh x energy_kwh / delivered_kg (p Assumed, swept)

design.log_miss: ln(miss_level_m), the implied mean |miss| in metres (= sigma_scale x the classical CLPS mean |miss|; E18 rows and rows without miss_level_m use sigma_scale x that mean)
design.offpad_share: offpad_landings / landings of the year (rows without a landings count: 0 when offpad_landings is 0, else dropped); lets the fit separate dispersion acting through off-pad events from any smooth effect
design.util: mean utilisation of the reference cell (sigma 1, standoff 1 km, 50 m pad, no keep-out) of the same scenario, mechanism and night fraction: a group-level covariate for fleet load, not the row's own utilisation
design.controls: mechanism dummies (inhouse is the base) and night_fraction; the per-mechanism fits drop the dummies
design.estimator: ordinary least squares, numpy lstsq; columns constant in the data are dropped and listed
design.ci: percentile bootstrap over seeds, N_BOOT resamples: seeds drawn with replacement, every row of a drawn seed enters with that seed's multiplicity (weighted normal equations), so the CI respects the common-random-number pairing

siting.flags: hauling Modelled; energy price Assumed; pad cost Spec (Metzger & Autry 2022), independent of standoff; impacts/landing Modelled from Wittal et al. (OTPS 2022) anchors, shield 0.1 Assumed when PAD_A LOS to BASE is blocked; damage cost per impact Assumed; delay valuation Assumed (blended $/item-hour stand-in for the engine's per-priority vot_usd_per_h)
siting.note: total = hauling (operator + priced energy) + amortised pad cost (independent of standoff) + expected plume damage (landings/yr x I(D) x shield x cost per impact) + delay valuation (delivered items x mean delay h x VoT, a blended stand-in for the engine's per-priority vot_usd_per_h 5000/1000/100); min_cost marks the argmin standoff per cell and cost assumption; table_E20_siting_min.csv lists the minima, table_E20_siting_shares.csv the share of minima at each standoff per (energy price, damage cost, VoT)
